notes:
Background: mid-market product team (customer support platform for e-commerce merchants). Evaluating Redwood because they need predictable latency and easy escalation to dedicated capacity later.

Primary ask: host chat agents with streaming responses and tool calling (order lookups, refunds). Ultra-sensitive to first-token latency — target <1.5s at p95 for interactive agent flows.

What we heard on discovery call: 
- "We can't have customers wait for the bot to start typing — first-token must feel instantaneous."
- Typical session length 6-12 turns, avg message ~50-80 tokens. Peak concurrency ~600 concurrent chats during peak sales events.
- Prefer hosted API to start for speed of integration; will evaluate Dedicated for heavy event-day traffic and to control costs.

Security/compliance notes: SOC2 in process (expected Q4), require SSO/SAML, audit logging, KMS key wrap, and EU data residency for some enterprise customers. Legal flagged retention and deletion SLA language — wants explicit retention controls.

POC plan agreed: 48-hour performance run on hosted_api using Redwood streaming SDK + tool-calling to their order-service stub. SE to instrument latency tracing (per-route, per-token). Metrics to collect: first-token p50/p95/p99, tail latency for streaming chunks, token cost per session, tool call success rate.

Commercial: pricing sensitivity — prefers usage + committed monthly for peak windows. Budget band expected $5k-$15k/month initially; expansion if Dedicated demonstrated cost savings.

Recent interactions: 
- 2025-06-10 discovery (30m) w/ Maya, PM, infra lead — interest confirmed.
- 2025-06-18 demo (60m) — streaming + tool-calling walkthrough; showed Redwood streaming SDK examples.
- 2025-07-02 technical deep-dive w/ SE (Ravi) and infra — discussed autoscaling, KV cache, and fallbacks. Fireflies token: ff_20250702_cerulean_demo_01.
- 2025-07-12 legal sent initial redlines re: data residency/retention.

Notes on risk: They will escalate to Dedicated if hosted cannot meet p95 first-token <1.5s under POC traffic. Budget signoff tied to POC success and detailed cost estimate for sustained peak loads.

Next steps (short): 
- Schedule POC kickoff (owner: Maya) — target start 2025-07-20.
- SE to provide POC runbook + instrumentation checklist by 2025-07-17.
- Pricing worksheet + potential committed-burst offer from pricing ops (deliver by 2025-07-22).

Sales shorthand / quick remarks: 
- Champion: Head of Product (Ana Ruiz) engaged.
- "If streaming feels snappy, we fast-track." 
- Potential to convert to Dedicated within 3-6 months if peak-day economics hold.
